reason: I already get my collab DMs on Instagram and WhatsApp, and I can usually tell the fake ones myself. Installing yet another app to paste DMs into feels like extra work, and I'm not sure cafés near me would actually send paid invites to someone with my follower count.
objection: Will local businesses really pay a small creator like me, or will I just end up with the same barter offers inside another app I have to keep checking?
would_change_my_mind: If it worked right inside WhatsApp, and a friend showed me she actually got a paid café or salon deal through it with the fee written down.
